author: DistroTube
description:
Let's play some Xonotic, a fast paced first person shooter available for Linux!  Xonotic is free and open source software and is probably in your distro's repos, or you can install via snap or flatpak .  If you want to chat with me while we play, I'll host a Zoom video call during the stream.  Zoom is also available in most repos as well as a snap or flatpak.

Join the Zoom call: https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84854205158?pwd=1v46bqyYBQ82bFREQqTrfcBpz1wlj8.1
